_comment: Original, IP-free assets for the hockey project. All characters are generic archetypes described purely by appearance; no real people, shows, teams, or trademarks are referenced. Home team = teal/white, Away team = red/black. priority 1 = essential (generate first to validate), 2 = roster depth, 3 = nice-to-have.

Wearing a teal and white senior-league hockey uniform: padded jersey, shoulder pads, padded shorts, shin guards, and ice skates. Full body, neutral A-pose with arms slightly away from the body, empty hands, symmetrical, realistic human proportions, photorealistic PBR materials, game-ready character.
